digest.component_or_area: LLM completion verification and recovery orchestration
propositions: completion.py and completion_recovery.py exceed the 800-LOC module-size CI cap and require decomposition along existing architectural seam boundaries rather than mechanical splitting

completion.py contains four distinct concerns—operation orchestration, child-closure gate determinism, epic-close bug-screen deterministic layer, and verdict reconciliation—that must move into separate modules while maintaining stable public re-export facades

completion_recovery.py contains three distinct concerns—criteria surface and admission bounds, failure taxonomy and diagnostics, and recovery orchestration—that must move into separate modules while keeping CompletionAgentStep and re-exports stable
epic_bug_screen.py must absorb the epic bug-screen deterministic layer (floor + candidate filter) to unify the entire screen logic in one module
All refactoring must be behavior-preserving with zero assertion changes; tests require import-path and monkeypatch-target updates only
Every moved symbol must remain patchable at its original dotted import path via stable re-export facades to keep existing test mocks and runtime callers valid
